title: The invisible journey of evaporation
description: A scientific magnification shows selected water molecules escaping the liquid surface. Water vapour is invisible; enlarged molecular symbols are a model.

style.reference: The living watershed · illustrated scientific atlas
style.artDirection: Semi-realistic layered vector landscape. Atmospheric mountain facets, sculpted foliage, restrained water highlights and precise scientific magnifications. Colour denotes substance; invisible vapour appears only as explicitly schematic molecules.

objects.label: MAGNIFIED SURFACE · MOLECULES NOT TO SCALE

stages.title: Look closely at liquid water
stages.description: The magnified surface reveals crowded water molecules. These enlarged symbols are a model, not visible bubbles.

stages.title: Some molecules escape
stages.description: Selected surface molecules have enough energy to leave the liquid. Evaporation happens at the surface, without boiling.

stages.title: Invisible vapour mixes with air
stages.description: Escaped molecules move farther apart in the air. The symbols fade because real water vapour is invisible.
